title: Track declared runs across an exact named-root drift refusal
outcome: Preserve exact first-tool declaration identity across root drift without allowing drifted native reservation, ordinary observation, artifact evidence, or verification credit. Admitted and independently registered runs keep their existing authority.
acceptance: Root drift after native S0 publication and before provider enqueue leaves enough exact identity to refuse the matching first provider tool with a reason and remedy.

Refused invocation does not create a history row, check, trace occurrence, artifact binding, or producer evidence across foreground, background, and late or duplicate callbacks. Separately proven unrelated commands can still be observed.

Admitted native and separately registered launcher runs keep exact run custody and their existing artifact and verification fences. Deterministic production-route tests cover drift and normal admission.
